sections.name: T min
sections.desc:
A ‘T scale’ function [dg C → <none>] (see 42.5, page 209) build into Daisy.

                                          dgC
   Default temperature function used for mineralization. Equation (6-13) in A10,
with a linear decrease beginning at 37 dg C, down to 0 at 60 dg C, according to
J.A. van Veen and M.J.Frissel. See also [Hansen et al., 1990]
